title: Cover registered-check endpoint precedence with compatible closing checkpoints
outcome: Closing regression tests and docs state how every qualifying check endpoint interacts with a compatible checkpoint, preserving revert detection.
acceptance: Add a closing test with a compatible checkpoint equal to the final content and differing X-to-Y-to-X registered-check endpoints, plus a checkpoint-differs-while-check-endpoints-equal case; assert the intended source-change result and document precedence without weakening conservative checks.
